name: Oklahoma City National Memorial
company: Oklahoma City National Memorial and Museum
unique: The field of 168 empty bronze chairs, the reflecting pool and the survivor tree, built on the site of the 1995 bombing with a museum that walks minute by minute.
buzz: People describe it as one of the most powerful memorials in the country; the museum is intense and not for young children. Free grounds.

name: National Cowboy and Western Heritage Museum
unique: A museum of the American West with Western paintings, saddles, firearms, a reconstructed town and the End of the Trail sculpture.
buzz: Bigger and better than expected, with serious art alongside the cowboy gear. Allow two hours.

name: Philbrook Museum of Art
unique: A 1920s Italianate villa turned art museum, with a strong Native American collection and formal gardens.
buzz: The house and the gardens are as good as the art, and the Native American collection is excellent.

name: Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge
unique: Free roaming bison, longhorn and elk in a granite range that rises out of the plains, with bouldering on 500-million year old rock and prairie dog towns.
buzz: Bison sightings are almost guaranteed and the climbing is world class; roads are narrow and the heat is real.

name: Cain's Ballroom
unique: A 1924 dance hall where Bob Wills and the Texas Playboys broadcast, still booking rock, country and indie acts under the original sign.
buzz: The room is legendary and the sound is good. Check the calendar and buy ahead.

name: Gathering Place
unique: A $465-million private park on the Arkansas River with a suspension bridge, a land bridge, giant slides and a boathouse, free, and better than most municipal parks in America.
buzz: Parents call it the best free family day in the region; the playground is enormous and the beer garden is a nice touch.

name: Price Tower
unique: Frank Lloyd Wright's only built skyscraper, a 19 story copper and concrete tower with tours and a small hotel.
buzz: For architecture people it is a pilgrimage, and the tour explains the design. The top floor view is a bonus.

name: Woody Guthrie Center
unique: A museum of the folk singer's life, with his lyrics, drawings, guitars and the archive of his recordings.
buzz: The archive is serious and the story is moving. Good for anyone interested in American music.

name: Outsiders House Museum
unique: The actual house from the 1983 film The Outsiders, restored by a fan with the original paint colors, props and a gift shop full of memorabilia.
buzz: Fans of the book and film make pilgrimages; the restoration is loving and the guides know the production stories.

name: Medicine Park
unique: A cobblestone resort town at the edge of the Wichita Mountains, with a creek, a swimming hole, cabins and a dam built of river rock.
buzz: The cobblestone buildings are charming and the creek is cool. Good base for the wildlife refuge.

name: Myriad Botanical Gardens
unique: A 17 acre downtown garden with a glass conservatory, a children's garden, a lake and an ice rink in winter.
buzz: The conservatory is the rainy day win and the outdoor gardens are free. Good for kids.

name: Turner Falls
unique: A 77-foot waterfall dropping into a natural swimming hole, with caves behind the falls and a rock slide, in the Arbuckle Mountains.
buzz: It is a beloved summer spot and gets dangerously crowded; go on a weekday and wear shoes for the rocks. Water levels vary.

name: Bricktown
unique: A warehouse district of brick buildings, restaurants, a canal with water taxis and a ballpark, next to downtown.
buzz: The canal walk is the thing to do and the food is decent. Busy on weekends.

name: Blue Whale of Catoosa
unique: A 20-foot smiling blue whale built as an anniversary gift in a roadside pond, now a Route 66 icon with a slide and picnic tables.
buzz: It is a five minute stop that makes people absurdly happy; the story of the man who built it is on the plaque.
